description: Create a project (a group of tasks, usually one per repo). Optional: any tool that takes project creates it on first use. Returns the existing project if one has this name (case-insensitive), without changing it: the reply says if your description or color wasn't applied (taskhold_update_project changes them). Says whether it was created, restored or already existed, plus its id. Fails on an invalid name or at the account's project ceiling (the error says what to do).

color.description: Hex color for the board, e.g. "#2f6fdb" (default: picked from the name)

name.description: Project name, e.g. the repo folder ("api-server")

name: taskhold_create_project
title: Create a project
